title: Spatial Play Four Window Quad Layout
description: Configure spatial play with four golden-layout windows in a 2x2 grid: left-top Shape, left-bottom Building, right-top Energy, right-bottom Structure Classic. Each viewport binds to its model definition; shared model space syncs derived models from shape.
summary: Spatial play now opens four golden-layout viewports in a 2×2 grid: Shape (top-left), Building (bottom-left), Energy (top-right), Structure Classic (bottom-right). Each pane binds to its model definition via a dedicated scene3d surface; shared model space state syncs derived models from shape (including structure.classic via chained transforms). Workbench document and details panels hold the tree and controls; shape pane keeps interaction editing.
